name: BRAND TEXT
description:
We change the everyday reality into a world of peace and tranquillity! Dreamland Spa & Wellness Centre is located at the Hilton Pyramids Golf Resort, 6 th of October area, minutes away from the hustle and bustle of Cairo City. The 1800 square meters centre is the ideal sanctuary for relaxation and wellbeing. An oasis of exceptional personal service and amenities!



Spa facilities : all-year-around Heated Indoors Swimming Pool, Heated Hydro-massage Pool, Sauna, Steam, Fitness room and Studio; 14 treatment cabins and up-standard spa equipment (dry are and wet area).



Comfort. Luxury. Service . Our mission is to give each client an experience that is beyond expectations. Outstanding service, experienced aestheticians, a complete professional range of Sothys Paris signature and individually tailored facials, hydro-therapy, aromatherapy-oils based spa therapy for body and mind well-being.
